text: 其中提到，期货公司从事境内期货经纪业务的，注册资本应当不低于人民币一亿元；从事境内期货经纪和期货交易咨询业务（以下合称基础类业务）的，注册资本应当不低于人民币二亿元。期货公司从事期货做市交易、期货资产管理、衍生品交易业务（以下合称交易类业务）之一的，注册资本应当不低于人民币五亿元；从事二种及以上交易类业务的，注册资本应当不低于人民币十亿元。期货公司同时从事基础类业务、交易类业务或者其他业务的，注册资本以数额要求最高者为准。
text_en: Among other things, it states that a futures company engaging in domestic futures brokerage business shall have registered capital of no less than RMB 100 million; a futures company engaging in domestic futures brokerage and futures trading consulting business (hereinafter collectively referred to as basic-type business) shall have registered capital of no less than RMB 200 million. A futures company engaging in any one of futures market-making trading, futures asset management, or derivatives trading business (hereinafter collectively referred to as trading-type business) shall have registered capital of no less than RMB 500 million; a futures company engaging in two or more types of trading-type business shall have registered capital of no less than RMB 1 billion. Where a futures company simultaneously engages in basic-type business, trading-type business, or other business, the registered capital shall be subject to the highest amount requirement.
